dialogue_lines.speaker: Sera
dialogue_lines.text: Pre-Reformation administrative Basic. Gavran's personal classification system.
The containment terms start here. Gavran's original language—before the Council redrafted it for the public record.
That's the Veranthos annex. We called it the penance clause. The Army of Light had a different name for it, but they weren't the ones who wrote it.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Torin
dialogue_lines.text: For what we did to the vergence. For what the technique cost the people we used it on. For the fact that we built a seal out of twelve chamber-bound anchors plus Gavran as the central keystone and called it strategy.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Ben
dialogue_lines.text: What did Gavran call the protocol?
the public Reformations dissolved the Army of Light. Ended the Jedi Lords. Centralized training. Bound the Order to Republic oversight. All of it real. All of it on the record.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Ben
dialogue_lines.text: But the Reformations didn't create this protocol,

dialogue_lines.speaker: Ben
dialogue_lines.text: They buried it. They carried it forward as a concealed layer—a penance the public settlement was never meant to name.
